A bounded first engagement

Diagnose the journey before prescribing the system.

The JourneyIQ Supply Chain Diagnostic is a typical 2–4 week, evidence-led review. It reconstructs the journey across ERP exports, spreadsheets and operational records, identifies repeatable root causes, and leaves leaders with an executive diagnostic, opportunity register and prioritised 90-day roadmap.
